Respo  Through: Mr. Amit Ahlawat, APP for Stat  with SI Arvind, PS GTB Encla  Mr. Gulshan Kr. Pal, Advocat  2.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 30.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 9642/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.172/2024 of PS G.T.B Enclave for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP for State accepts notice and submits that there is no serious objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no.2 identified by IO/SI Arvind also accepts notice.
5. For recording statement of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 07.04.2026.
